interpretationRules: Use exact-source press and independent external photo credits as capability evidence.
Keep publication, client, partner, membership, commission, event participation and endorsement as distinct relationship types.
Do not bind a source to a service unless the source itself supports that capability or the canonical artistic registry documents the relationship.
Do not use pending candidates in schema, service claims or trust projections until direct attribution/context is publicly verifiable.
BANHALMI ART remains the canonical full press/artistic archive; this dataset is a professional service mapping layer only.
